clue.text: He importantly alerts police to excellent cannabis

parts.note: super is a casual word for excellent
grass is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: Someone tips off the police about some top-quality weed.
explanation.walkthrough: A SUPERGRASS is British slang for an informer whose evidence brings down many criminals at once.
explanation.definitionFit: An informer who tells the police about many criminals is the slang sense here.

clue.text: Thus twice as indifferent

indicators.note: twice says the word for thus is written two times over

parts.note: so means thus, in that way

explanation.surface: Something is done in the same way two times over.
explanation.definitionFit: Middling or mediocre, neither good nor bad, is the sense shared.

clue.text: Work of poor art, I bet-churned out to get money in

definitions.text: Work of poor art, I bet-churned out to get money in

parts.words: Work of poor art, I bet-churned out to get money in
parts.note: a second-rate book or picture produced quickly by a hack just to keep the pot boiling, i.e. to earn a living

explanation.surface: A hack dashes off a bad picture purely for cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Hack writing or art produced merely to earn a living is exactly what the clue describes.

clue.text: Walk about mountains

definitions.meaning: to roam or wander over an area
a chain of hills or peaks

explanation.surface: Someone goes hiking among the peaks.
explanation.definitionFit: To roam freely is one sense; a chain of peaks, as in the Rockies, is the other.

clue.text: But it wasn't just Soviet bureaucracy

definitions.text: But it wasn't just Soviet bureaucracy

parts.words: But it wasn't just Soviet bureaucracy
parts.note: Soviet suggests the colour of communism plus a binding strip, yet the phrase means officialdom anywhere, not only in the USSR

explanation.surface: A remark that paperwork and officialdom were not unique to the Soviet Union.
explanation.walkthrough: Red is the traditional colour of communism, which is why 'Soviet' points at the first word.
explanation.definitionFit: Excessive official rules and form-filling go by this name, from the ribbon once used to tie up documents.

clue.text: Do well to follow

definitions.meaning: to come after, as an heir takes over a throne

explanation.surface: A piece of advice about prospering by imitating others.
explanation.definitionFit: Prospering is one sense; coming next in line after someone is the other.

clue.text: Sounds like two fruit

indicators.note: says the word meaning two is to be heard rather than written

parts.note: a pair is a set of two

explanation.surface: Someone thinks they hear a reference to a couple of pieces of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchard tree's soft, tapering fruit, like a Conference or Bartlett.

clue.text: Flat time at special occasion

parts.note: even means level, flat

explanation.surface: An apartment is booked for a party at a set hour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flat' reads like a British apartment, but here it means level.
explanation.definitionFit: A notable happening or planned function, such as a gala, is the sense.

clue.text: Emma is hurt badly by this complaint

indicators.note: badly signals that the letters are jumbled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Poor Emma is suffering from a painful ailment.
explanation.definitionFit: A painful condition of joints and muscles is the illness meant by complaint.

clue.text: Sly pup at play with another animal

indicators.note: play suggests the letters are moving about freely into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A crafty puppy romps with a creature of a different species.
explanation.walkthrough: The fodder is the eight letters of 'Sly pup at'; 'play' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An Australian egg-laying mammal with a duck's bill is one creature among many.

clue.text: Relaxed wearing fine fabric

parts.note: sat means rested, relaxed in a chair
in means wearing, as in dressed in silk

explanation.surface: Someone lounges dressed in a luxurious material.
explanation.definitionFit: A glossy smooth cloth woven from silk or similar is a luxury material.

clue.text: Dress down thus for formal occasion?

definitions.text: Dress down thus for formal occasion?

parts.words: Dress down thus for formal occasion?
parts.note: dress down suggests casual clothes, but here a gown cut low at the neck, the neckline going down, worn to a ball

explanation.surface: Advice to wear something casual to a smart event.
explanation.definitionFit: A low-cut neckline on an evening gown, from French for bared neck and shoulders.

clue.text: Be beaten, and look to shed dignity

parts.note: to lose is to be beaten
face means look or expression

explanation.surface: A defeated competitor is told to brace for humiliation.
explanation.definitionFit: Being humiliated, losing the respect of others, is the idiom meant.

clue.text: Bear, mark, is a symbolic animal

parts.note: to tote is to carry or bear
M is an abbreviation for mark, the old German currency

explanation.surface: A bear called Mark is the emblem of a tribe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bear' looks like the animal but is the verb to carry.
explanation.definitionFit: A creature venerated as a tribe's emblem, as on carved poles of the Pacific Northwest.

clue.text: Gambler takes drink for wife

parts.note: a better is one who bets
a half is a half-pint of beer in British pubs

explanation.surface: A gambler has a drink rather than going home to his spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A jocular idiom for one's spouse or partner.

clue.text: Naturally, a brief screening of highlights?

definitions.text: Naturally, a brief screening of highlights?

parts.words: Naturally, a brief screening of highlights?
parts.note: not a television round-up of sports highlights but nature briefly hiding the brightest lights in the sky, the sun or moon

explanation.surface: A short television show of sporting best bits.
explanation.definitionFit: The Moon passing in front of the Sun briefly blots out its light, a natural screening.

clue.text: Stately journey made by prince and terrible woman

parts.note: an ogress is a frightening female monster

explanation.surface: A royal and a fearsome lady make a ceremonial tour.
explanation.definitionFit: A royal tour through the realm, as Elizabeth I made, is an old sense.

clue.text: Security is held back in store

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside the word for store

parts.note: a depot is a storehouse

indicators.note: held back says the little word is to be read backwards

explanation.surface: Safety is being withheld in a warehouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held back' turns IS into SI, which goes inside DEPOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Money paid as a pledge against loss or damage is a form of security.

clue.text: Being frugal, leave piece for future use

parts.note: spare can mean economical or frugal
to part is to leave or go away

explanation.surface: A thrifty person keeps a component in reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: A replacement component kept in reserve against a breakdown.

clue.text: Leave main road-it is a bore

definitions.meaning: to come off a highway onto a side road
something that puts you off, unappealing

explanation.surface: A driver finds the motorway tedious and pulls off.
explanation.definitionFit: Exiting onto a side road is one sense; something off-putting or dull is the other.

clue.text: Pardon four involved in fake

indicators.note: involved in says the roman numeral goes inside the other word

parts.note: to forge is to fake
IV is four in roman numerals

explanation.surface: A forger is let off despite four counts of counterfeiting.
explanation.definitionFit: To excuse an offence and stop resenting it is to pardon.

clue.text: Said my poor start to season causes gloom

indicators.note: poor suggests the words are in bad shape and need rearranging
start to points at the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A weak opening to the football season has made everyone glum.
explanation.definitionFit: Dismay is distress or alarm, so to cause it is to depress or appal.

clue.text: Ordered notes on statement of belief

parts.note: D is a musical note
E is another musical note
a creed is a formal statement of faith

explanation.surface: Notes written on a confession of faith were commanded.
explanation.definitionFit: Decreed means officially commanded or ruled by authority.

clue.text: Argumentative boat, man?

definitions.meaning: one who rows, that is quarrels noisily
one who propels a boat with oars

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a quarrelsome type is a boatman.
explanation.walkthrough: The first sense rhymes with 'cow'; the second with 'go'.
explanation.definitionFit: An oarsman is one sense; someone given to quarrels, from row meaning dispute, is the other.

clue.text: Ladies conquered and enslaved me

indicators.note: enslaved says the second piece is held captive inside the first

parts.note: won means conquered, triumphed

explanation.surface: A man laments that the fair sex beat and captured him.
explanation.definitionFit: Ladies is a polite synonym for adult females.

clue.text: Better perhaps being on track

parts.note: a gambler, one who bets, attending the racecourse; better is a person, not an improvement

explanation.surface: Things look as if they are improving and going according to plan.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone attending horse races, often to place bets.

clue.text: Sound very good? Sound incongruous

indicators.note: Sound asks for the word meaning very good to be heard, not spelt

parts.note: great means very good

explanation.surface: A question about whether something sounds excellent, answered that it sounds wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: To jar or rasp, making a harsh discordant noise, is the verb sense.

clue.text: Terror of loud organ

parts.note: F is forte, the musical abbreviation for loud
the ear is the organ of hearing

explanation.surface: A deafening church instrument inspires dread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organ' suggests the musical instrument but is a body part.
explanation.definitionFit: Dread or fright is the shared sense.

clue.text: End of fighting-it's a crime to scrap

indicators.note: scrap signals breaking the words up and rebuilding them

explanation.surface: Someone declares that ending hostilities would be wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scrap' could mean a fight, fitting the surface, but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A truce agreed between warring sides ends the fighting.

clue.text: Knowing a conflict has point

parts.note: war is armed conflict
E is a point of the compass, east

explanation.surface: A war is being fought with a definite purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: Being informed or conscious of something.

clue.text: Choice of penalty

definitions.meaning: of the best quality, as choice cuts

explanation.surface: Someone may choose a form of punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: Excellent quality is one sense; a monetary punishment is the other.

clue.text: Law not applicable to departed landlord

parts.note: dead means departed, passed away
a letter is one who lets property

explanation.surface: A tenancy rule no longer binds a landlord who has died.
explanation.definitionFit: A statute still on the books but no longer enforced.
